title: Two Sum with Single Target
statement: Given an array of integers nums and a single target, return the index of the number that equals the target.
hints: Use a dictionary to store the indices of the numbers
Iterate through the array and check if the difference between the target and the current number is in the dictionary
explanation: This variant simplifies the original problem by only requiring the index of a single number that equals the target.

title: Two Sum with Limited Memory
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target, with the constraint that you can only store the last seen number in memory.
constraints: You can only store the last seen number in memory
hints: Use a dictionary to store the last seen number
Iterate through the array only once
explanation: This variant requires the candidate to optimize the solution by only storing the last seen number in memory.
